errors.description: mail_payload_q is a multi-bit value produced in apb_clk and sampled directly in mailbox_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
write_pulse_q is a one-cycle apb_clk pulse consumed directly in mailbox_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
write_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample mailbox_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in mailbox_event_o.
mailbox_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector mailbox_mode_q before decoding in mailbox_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
apb_rst_n is used as data inside mailbox_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
irq_snapshot_q combines apb_clk payload state with mailbox_clk status state in irq_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
